decision.086A: Close this fixed-equal recipe; no additional seed, coefficient search or extra updates.
decision.086B: Keep the already running position-only arm and paired CPU comparison unchanged; A alone does not answer whether auxiliary supervision harms position at the fixed position coefficient.
decision.author_baseline_claim: This is a task-adapted PTFM control, not a demonstrated reproduction or evidence against the author method.

independent_reaggregation.method: Recompute MAE and MSE from per-scene values weighted by their saved unit_count for every nonempty stratum/arm/weighting, globally, in each of 38 components, and outside the largest component. All unit counts agree. Assert math.isclose with rel_tol=1e-12 and abs_tol=1e-7.
independent_reaggregation.quantiles: P95 and P99 were read from source summaries; they cannot be independently reconstructed from scene aggregate quantiles.

population.position_groups_representatives_and_mask: Source comparison contracts report unchanged full population and masks.

training_review.coefficient_interpretation: Per valid sample/task the coefficient is 1/3; an absent label task contributes zero, explaining window averages slightly below 1/3. These are fixed coefficients, not inferred learned weights.
training_review.contribution_caution: Equal coefficients do not imply equal objective contributions or equal gradients; numerical task contributions do not establish causal optimization allocation.
training_review.window_caution: Different training windows expose different data. Their loss decline is not a fixed-T initial/final evaluation and does not prove a T/V generalization gap.

fixed_prior095_position_and_ptfm_random_.caution: Position is the fixed .95 prior; auxiliary values are PTFM random heads, not ordinary Mean speed/heading controls.

scene_component_review.interpretation: The negative position outcome is broad across scenes, components and population weightings; it is not explained only by one extreme scene or changed evaluation population.

receipt_corrections.claim: The constant three-task objective moves optimization quality from position to speed/heading.
receipt_corrections.correction: Unsupported. Compared with adaptive 076B at the fixed endpoint, all three MAEs are worse. Auxiliary improvement from random initialization demonstrates learning but not an incremental auxiliary benefit of fixed weights or a causal transfer of optimization quality.

receipt_corrections.claim: All three initial attributes exactly match 076B / fixed .95.
receipt_corrections.correction: All initial states exactly match 076B. Only position is the fixed .95 physical prior; auxiliary initial outputs are random PTFM heads and differ from the ordinary Mean speed/heading controls.

audit_limits: Read-only review of committed source code, run metadata, exposure dictionaries, training-window summaries and compressed per-scene/component comparisons.
Actual checkpoint parameters, complete 4000-batch training.jsonl and raw per-scene NPZ arrays remain on the server; local review did not independently reload or replay those originals.
Initial parameter and exact successful-batch checks are server-side reported checks reinforced by the matching local exposure/normalizer metadata, not new local checkpoint verification.
No new model forward, optimization, original-data access or T_test access was performed.
The no-qualified-unsupervised-auxiliary-head limitation applies to position-only 086B, not to all-supervised 086A.
No claim that low auxiliary MAE establishes temporal dynamics or the benefit of multiple sources; prior 076A diagnostics cannot automatically be inherited by this different endpoint.
